description: Ownership marker `.fgos-confinement-owner.json` (OWNERSHIP_MARKER_FILE, src/runner/dispatch/confinement/cleanup.mjs) of a confinement home created for an attempt. Version 2 carries no pid and no pane: the attempt lock decides whether the home may be removed, and only the adopt door (finalize-home) removes it. Version 1 markers (contract `confinement-resource-ownership.v1`) keep the old reaper rules until they are gone; the old reader accepts only the v1 contract string, so it ignores version 2.

fields.dispatchId: string, the per-dispatch parent directory name, as in version 1
fields.resource: string, the confined resource name, as in version 1

extension: extendOwnershipMarker may add facts known after the home is filled (e.g. the account login it was copied from); it never adds pid, pane or binder fields
removalRule: remove only through finalize-home run by the supervisor or by adopt while it holds the attempt lock and containment.is_empty(domain) == empty
